task: Audit, Consolidate, and Prune .agent Directory to Reduce Token Bloat

tasks.title: Audit .agent Tree, Stale Cache Artifacts, and Token Footprint
tasks.description: Inspect all files and directories inside `.agent/` (including `rules/`, `skills/`, `agents/`, `tools/`, `memory/`, `context/`, `workflows/`, and config files). Identify redundant explanations, bloated chat transcript dumps, duplicate API catalogs already present in `docs-site/src/data/`, stale temporary output files, and unpruned `.agentignore` exclusions.

tasks.title: Strengthen .agent/.agentignore Exclusions
tasks.description: Ensure `.agent/.agentignore` explicitly prevents heavy binaries, logs, test outputs, and compiler caches from being pulled into the LLM context window. Verify exclusions for `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.next/`, `docs-site/out/`, `docs-site/.next/`, `coverage/`, `scratch/`, `output/`, `*.pptx`, `*.xlsx`, `*.zip`, `*.log`, and temporary raw XML diff fixtures.

tasks.title: Consolidate and Deduplicate Rules, Memory, and Architectural Docs
tasks.description: Refactor and prune prose in `.agent/rules/` (`general.md`, `features.md`, `io-whitelist.md`), `.agent/memory/architectural-decisions.md`, and `.agent/project_summary.md`. Replace verbose narrative descriptions with compact bullet points, concise table maps, and targeted code constraints while retaining critical invariants (zero native dependencies, pure JS, 18-method I/O boundary, XML security, run healing, and chart/table integrity rules).

tasks.title: Streamline Agent Roster, Skills, and Workflow SOPs
tasks.description: Optimize `.agent/AGENTS.md`, `.agent/agents/*.md`, and `.agent/workflows/*.md`. Consolidate overlapping instructions between agent role definitions and individual skill playbooks (`skills/*.md`). Purge deprecated workflows or duplicate schema definitions that mirror `docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json`.

tasks.title: Validate Total Context Size and Test Agent Performance
tasks.description: Verify that total character/token weight of the `.agent/` directory is significantly reduced without breaking Antigravity agent role execution or omitting core OpenXML/OPC constraints. Ensure the project build (`npm test`) and documentation export (`npm run docs:build`) remain completely unaffected.
